method: Three emitted Gaussian spectral basis coefficients + exact signed XYZ residual; preintegrated KM/Beer-Lambert response matrices, linear density interpolation
scene_semantics: Relative attenuation of reconstructed scene radiance plus unchanged signed residual. Does not simulate a rendered print, viewing illuminant, observer appearance, or a display transform. Spectral reflectance supplies an attenuation trajectory only.
physical_properties_retained: radiometric exposure scaling for fixed selection
limitations: Only three reconstruction basis functions; residual may dominate extreme colors
Neutral/red anchoring and chroma coupling are creative controls, not physical laws
Scene-relative fitting and visual acceptance still require structured and image validation
